name: 5-fluoro-EPT
summary: 5-Fluoro-EPT (5F-EPT, 5-fluoro-N-ethyl-N-propyltryptamine) is a psychedelic tryptamine derivative related to drugs such as EPT and 5-MeO-EPT.54 nM and an efficacy of 104% (compared to serotonin). It produces a head-twitch response in animal studies, and is claimed to have antidepressant activity.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a potent full agonist at the 5-HT2A receptor with an EC50 of 5.54 nM and an efficacy of 104% (compared to serotonin).

uses.en: It is a research compound and has also been sold online as a designer drug.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，也曾在網路上作為設計師藥物販售。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，也曾在网络上作为设计师药物贩售。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic tryptamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: A fluorine atom at the 5 position of the indole ring blocks the spot where the body would normally attach a hydroxy group, which changes how quickly the drug is broken down.
fact.zh: 吲哚環第5位上的氟原子，占住了身體通常會接上羥基的位置，因而改變了藥物被分解的速度。
fact.zhHans: 吲哚环第5位上的氟原子，占住了身体通常会接上羟基的位置，因而改变了药物被分解的速度。
